title: ProjectSetupState
description: Tracks progress of the project-setup skill. Written to .kiro/setup-state.json. Reentrant: skill resumes from last completed phase.

completed.description: True only when all mandatory phases are done and steering files are written. Skill exits immediately if true.

answers.description: Keyed by question ID (q1..q25). Values are the architect's answers. Never contains client names in keys.

files_written.description: Paths of steering files written by this skill run.

open_questions.description: Questions answered with TBD or deferred; logged to docs/architecture/open-questions.md.
